title: Second day of taping; recap of the first tour
summary: Resuming on January 27, Dupre recaps that the first tour ended in November 1924 and asks about the move to vaudeville.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We're back making a tape, and it's January 27. You were telling yesterday about some advice that Mr. Willis Young gave you about some of the girls hanging around the bandstand, the dance rats.

We talked about the family band and what kind of tunes they were doing and what they were into. You were talking up to the period of that first tour, when you were playing in the carnival show, in the family band.
I think yesterday you said it was March to November of '24.
What happened in November? Did he go to vaudeville.
Do you want to explain about that? What exactly happened and what kind of changes went over on the show?
